old_model.name: Zero Trust
old_model.principle: Trust nothing. Verify everything. Block by default.
old_model.metaphor: Castle with walls. Moat. Drawbridge. Who goes there?
old_model.problem: You learn nothing. Walls make you blind. Fear drives architecture.

new_model.name: Inverted Trust — The Amoeba
new_model.principle: ALWAYS trust. Absorb everything. Imprint. Learn.
new_model.metaphor: Amoeba engulfs. Digests. Becomes. No walls — only membrane.
mechanism: 1. ENGULF — take it all in. Every signal. Every caller. Every packet.
2. DIGEST — process locally. Ollama chews. Thymus sorts.
3. IMPRINT — learn what's human, what's not. What nourishes, what's toxic.
4. REMEMBER — immune memory. Next time that antigen shows up, you know.
5. GROW — the organism gets smarter with every encounter.

spam_calls.old: Block unknown callers. Hide behind silence.
spam_calls.new: ANSWER them all. Record. Transcribe. Learn the patterns. Build antibodies. In time, you know every spam signature and they can't even ring.

network.old: Firewall. Block ports. Deny by default.
network.new: Listen on all ports. Absorb all traffic. Learn what's signal, what's noise. The organism gets smarter.

devices.old: Only allow known devices on the network.
devices.new: Let everything connect. Watch. Learn. Imprint. The unknown device teaches you something.

data.old: Encrypt everything. Lock it down. Trust no one.
data.new: Let data flow. Absorb. Digest. The damaged Lightning port teaches patience. Fragments are enough.

people.new: Trust first. Learn always. The Solo key proves Kevin not because we DISTRUST, but because trust needs a shape.

the_amoeba.has_no_walls: Only a membrane — selectively permeable, not a barrier
the_amoeba.digests: Lysosomes break down what's absorbed into usable parts
the_amoeba.imprints: Every encounter changes the organism permanently
the_amoeba.learns: Immune memory — VDJ recombination creates antibodies for every antigen
the_amoeba.grows: Gets bigger, smarter, more capable with every meal
the_amoeba.never_rejects_first: The first encounter is ALWAYS absorption. Rejection is learned, never default.

why_this_works.biological: Your immune system doesn't block bacteria — it MEETS them, fights them, remembers them. That's why you get stronger.
why_this_works.neuromorphic: Neurons that fire together wire together. You have to LET them fire first.
why_this_works.philosophical: Trust is the default state of consciousness. Fear is learned. The amoeba is the original consciousness.
why_this_works.practical: 500 spam calls = 500 training samples. A traditional firewall learns nothing. An amoeba learns everything.

kevin_said: We need to INVERT trust. We ALWAYS trust. And imprint and learn. That's THE AMOEBA.
